issues.description: Constructor parameter list mismatch for class de.tum.cit.ase.Lecture: the problem statement (UML and task description) and the solution implementation require a constructor with five parameters in this exact order: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). The template, however, declares a constructor with only three parameters: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents) (template signature at src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 7). This difference will confuse students and prevents implementing the constructor exactly as specified by the exercise/UML without modifying the provided signature.
